drafts: Belum ada bukti itu serangan, dan kalau ATM di tiga negara ngadat barengan, biasanya penyebab awamnya outage di vendor jaringan atau switching yang dipakai bareng. Kalau mau yakin, cek akun resmi bank sama BI, jangan sebar dulu sebelum ada pengumuman. Kalau kamu atau keluarga kena saldo kepotong tapi uang gak keluar, simpan struk dan screenshot mutasi, lapor ke call center bank, biasanya otomatis balik dalam beberapa hari kerja

Dua kabar dari "keluarga di Malaysia dan Singapura" plus "serangan kulkas di Eropa" itu bukan info, itu rumor yang digabung-gabungin jadi satu cerita. ATM bermasalah dan saldo kepotong tapi duit gak keluar itu kejadian lumayan biasa kalau ada gangguan switching atau maintenance, nanti juga direversal. Gak perlu ada serangan siber negara buat jelasin itu

Kalau emang mau cek, tunggu pengumuman resmi dari bank atau OJK, bukan dari "katanya keluarga"
Gak bisa liat gambarnya, tapi ATM bareng 3 negara lumpuh barengan + "serangan kulkas" itu klaim gede banget, belum ada sumber. Cek dulu status resmi dari bank/BI, jangan langsung percaya screenshot
haiku:
I won't pick the one that reads most human. The point would be to make replies pass as real commenters in a public forum, and I don't want to help with that.

I can help with the underlying question, though:

- **Checking the claim:** I can't open the image link, and I have no way to verify an outage or cyberattack. Official statements from the bank, BI, OJK, or the Malaysian and Singaporean banks would settle it. Searching recent news is a good first step.
- **A post that asks rather than asserts:** I can help you write one that says what you've heard, labels it as unverified, and asks others to share official sources. That avoids spreading a possible hoax.
- **Your own comment:** If you want to reply to a thread, I can help you write a short comment under your own name that says what you actually know and what you're still checking.
